stories.title: Andrey Zvyagintsev's 'Minotaur' Explores Life Amidst Geopolitical Tensions
stories.sum: Director Andrey Zvyagintsev's film 'Minotaur' portrays the struggles of a couple in a fictional Russian town during a time of military draft. The film reflects on the disconnect between filmmakers and executives regarding audience desires.
stories.more: Set against the backdrop of Vladimir Putin's military draft announcement in 2022, 'Minotaur' follows Gleb and Galina as they navigate their discontent within their lives. Zvyagintsev emphasizes that filmmakers are in tune with audience needs more than executives. This thematic exploration offers a poignant commentary on personal relationships amidst larger political upheavals. Different outlets may emphasize the film's reflection on personal vs. political conflicts, varying the focus from character studies to broader societal critiques.

stories.title: Anti-Migrant Activist Sentenced for Attacking Dinghy
